brief:
Hamas warned that Israeli revocation of entry permits for Palestinians to access their homes and lands in villages northwest of Jerusalem constitutes systematic displacement policy, Shehab Wire reported. The group described the measure as part of broader plans to expel residents and alter the city's demographic character.

The permit system restricts Palestinian movement in occupied East Jerusalem and surrounding areas under Israeli control. Hamas said the revocations prevent Palestinians from reaching their property and maintaining residency in the city.
dek: Hamas warned that Israeli revocation of entry permits for Palestinians to access their homes and lands in villages northwest of Jerusalem constitutes systematic displacement policy, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Hamas condemns permit revocations displacing Palestinians from Jerusalem homes
